hypotheses.reasoning: account-svc v2.5.0 was rolled out at 02:27:57 (#1173, replacing v2.4.5; ready at #1208). Starting at #1297 (02:29:56), failing POST /login requests hit a TypeError reading 'tier' in user-formatter.ts:78 under v2.5.0 (#1386, #1398). A user record field is undefined, so login returns 500. edge-proxy 500s (#1277, #1511, #1756, #1795) are downstream symptoms of the upstream account-svc 500s. Pre-deploy account-svc logs show no errors. billing-reconciler checksum errors (#515, #739, #980, #1171, #1481, #1593, #1897) only hit 2019 invoice_archive partitions and are not on the login path. Confidence is capped because I did not inspect the formatter code or the records missing 'tier'.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back account-svc from v2.5.0 to v2.4.5 now to stop the 500s. Then fix user-formatter.ts:78 to handle a missing tier (null-guard or default) and find which user records lack the tier field. Track the invoice_archive checksum violations separately as a data-integrity issue with the billing team.
